description:
Extend the existing BCH Criterion benches to the workload-selection contract: field-generic and AVX2 large-batch encoding and generator-matrix materialization, with worker-count sweeps and dispatch-path reporting.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Criterion targets cover both selected workloads on the canonical model, binary and nonbinary, reporting the dispatch path taken.
- [hard] REQ-02: Benchmarks run on the existing harness conventions and emit data consumable by the receipt task.
title: Extend Criterion benchmarks to the selected workloads
